units.source_text: 明石姬本人的悲伤之情，更加不可言喻。

en.t: Lady Akashi's own grief was even more beyond words.

units.source_text: 她不欲被人看出，努力镇静。

en.t: She did not want anyone to notice it, and struggled to remain composed.

units.source_text: 她觉得自己身份的低微，是这悲伤的主因。

en.t: She felt that her lowly status was the main cause of this sorrow.

units.source_text: 公子的返京原是不得已之事，但此身竟被遗弃，此恨难以自慰。

en.t: The young lord's return to the capital had indeed been unavoidable, but to be left behind herself filled her with a bitterness she could not soothe.

units.source_text: 加之公子的面影常在眼前，永不能忘，因此除了哭泣之外，别无办法。

en.t: Moreover, his face was always before her eyes and could never be forgotten, so she could do nothing but weep.

units.source_text: 母夫人也无话可安慰她，只是埋怨丈夫：“亏你想得出这种倒霉的办法！

en.t: Her mother, too, had no words with which to comfort her, and only reproached her husband: "How could you ever have thought up such an unlucky scheme!

units.source_text: 总而言之，是我疏忽大意，轻信了你这老顽固的话，以致铸成大错！”

en.t: In short, I was careless and foolishly trusted the words of an old stubborn man like you, and so made this terrible mistake!"

units.source_text: 明石道人答道：“罢了，不要噜苏了！

en.t: The Akashi monk replied, "Enough, stop going on and on!

units.source_text: 公子决不会抛弃她，其中自有缘故。

en.t: The young lord will certainly not abandon her; there must be reasons behind this.

units.source_text: 目前虽然别去，定然会考虑办法。

en.t: Although he has parted from her for now, he will surely think of some way.

units.source_text: 叫她放心，吃点补药吧。

en.t: Tell her to set her mind at ease and take some strengthening medicine.

units.source_text: 啼啼哭哭是不祥的呵！”

en.t: It is unlucky to keep crying like that!"

units.source_text: 说罢，将身子靠在屋角里了。

en.t: After saying this, he leaned his body into a corner of the room.

units.source_text: 乳母和母夫人等还在议论明石道人的顽固与失策，她们说：“几年来一直巴望她早些嫁个如意郎。

en.t: The nurse, the mother, and the others were still talking about the Akashi monk's stubbornness and poor judgment, saying, "For years we had been hoping she would soon marry a worthy man.

units.source_text: 今番总以为如愿以偿了，岂知才得开始，即便遭逢不幸！”

en.t: This time we thought our wish had finally come true, but who could have known that misfortune would strike just as it began!"

units.source_text: 明石道人听了这些叹声，更加可怜这女儿，心情越发烦乱了。

en.t: Hearing these laments, the Akashi monk pitied his daughter all the more, and his heart grew increasingly troubled.

units.source_text: 白天，他昏昏沉沉地睡一天，到了夜间，骨碌爬起来。

en.t: By day he slept the whole day in a daze, and when night came he suddenly scrambled up.

units.source_text: 说着：“念珠也不知哪里去了。”

en.t: He muttered, "I wonder where my prayer beads have gone."

units.source_text: 就合掌拜佛。

en.t: Then he pressed his palms together and worshiped the Buddha.

units.source_text: 徒弟们怪他懈怠，他就在月夜出门，想走到佛堂里去做功课。

en.t: When his disciples blamed him for neglecting his duties, he went out on a moonlit night, intending to walk to the Buddhist hall to perform his devotions.

units.source_text: 岂知途中一个失脚，掉进池塘里，又被那些棱角突兀的假山石撞伤了腰。

en.t: But on the way he missed his footing and fell into the pond, and then injured his back against the sharp, jutting rocks of the artificial hill.

units.source_text: 卧病期间，稍稍忘怀了女儿之事。

en.t: While he lay ill, he forgot his daughter's affairs for a little while.
